subject: English
passage: Nanoparticles are tiny particles that are smaller than a cell. These microscopic particles can be found in high concentrations in urban air pollution. Environmental scientist Troy Blackwell and his team are studying the role that certain mosses have in filtering nanoparticles from the air. Through research, his team has found that these mosses may be absorbing up to 15 million particles per square meter each year through their surface structures.
prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Environmental scientists are interested in learning more about how certain mosses grow in urban environments.
choices.B: Questions remain around the impact certain mosses have on air quality in cities.
choices.C: Nanoparticles are tiny particles that can be found in urban air pollution.
choices.D: Environmental scientists suggest that mosses filter large numbers of nanoparticles from urban air.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The text describes a study about how certain mosses filter nanoparticles from the air, which found that these mosses are absorbing 15 million particles per square meter through their surface structures.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. While the researchers are studying mosses in urban environments, the focus of their study isn't how the mosses grow. Rather, they're studying how mosses may be filtering nanoparticles from the air.
